title: Paedodontics I: Main Exam, 20 December 2018
instructions: Answer ALL questions in section A and answer ANY TWO questions from

items.text: Section B ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS
Discuss strategies that can be put in place towards prevention of oral diseases in children.
In details describe developmental anomalities of both dentitions outlining the management of these anomalities.
Discuss the cause of dental pain in children and methods that can be used to control the pain.
